key: DIAGNOSIS: Obsessive Compulsive Disorder
en: DIAGNOSIS: Obsessive Compulsive Disorder
ja: 診断名: 強迫性障害

key: NOTES: Client portrays a discomfort with odd numbers, and a particular mild fixation with multiples of eight.
en: NOTES: Client portrays a discomfort with odd numbers, and a particular mild fixation with multiples of eight.
ja: 所見: 患者は奇数に不快感を示し、特に8の倍数に対して軽度の執着を見せる。

key: Client describes an elevated level of cognitive discomfort in response to perceived stimuli of germs and bacteria.
en: Client describes an elevated level of cognitive discomfort in response to perceived stimuli of germs and bacteria.
ja: 患者は、細菌や雑菌の刺激を知覚すると、認知的な不快感が高まると訴えている。

key: Client refuses to perform daily tasks and engage with others without wearing gloves.
en: Client refuses to perform daily tasks and engage with others without wearing gloves.
ja: 患者は手袋を着用しない限り、日常動作や他者との関わりを拒否する。

key: Client tends to occupy communal hygiene spaces for several hours at a time.
en: Client tends to occupy communal hygiene spaces for several hours at a time.
ja: 患者は共用の衛生スペースを、一度に数時間占有する傾向がある。

key: Client describes a particular memory in which she was able to maintain emotional composure when fleeing a burning residence by focusing negatively on the feeling of smoke on her skin.
en: Client describes a particular memory in which she was able to maintain emotional composure when fleeing a burning residence by focusing negatively on the feeling of smoke on her skin.
ja: 患者は、燃える家から逃げる際、肌にまとわりつく煙の感覚に意識を向けることで、精神的な平静を保てたという特異な記憶を語っている。

key: It is the opinion of this writer that her fixation on cleanliness is an attempt to physically relieve mental discomfort caused by past trauma.
en: It is the opinion of this writer that her fixation on cleanliness is an attempt to physically relieve mental discomfort caused by past trauma.
ja: 本記録者の見解では、彼女の清潔さへの執着は、過去のトラウマに起因する精神的不快感を、身体的に緩和しようとする試みである。

key: TREATMENT PLAN: Psychoanalytic talk therapy in consideration of how repressed guilt from childhood trauma may contribute to atypical behavior.
en: TREATMENT PLAN: Psychoanalytic talk therapy in consideration of how repressed guilt from childhood trauma may contribute to atypical behavior.
ja: 治療方針: 幼少期のトラウマによる抑圧された罪悪感が、異常行動にどう影響しているかを考慮した精神分析的対話療法。

key: ECT has been explored as a subsidiary treatment in acute peaks of anxiety, and to correct pervasive emotional imbalances."
en: ECT has been explored as a subsidiary treatment in acute peaks of anxiety, and to correct pervasive emotional imbalances."
ja: ECTは、不安が急性のピークに達した際の補助治療として、また慢性的な感情の不均衡を是正するために検討されている。」

key: "Saphira Belrose"
en: "Saphira Belrose"
ja: 「サファイラ・ベルローズ」

key: AGE AT INTAKE: 15 years
en: AGE AT INTAKE: 15 years
ja: 入所時年齢: 15歳

key: DIAGNOSIS: Oppositional Defiance Disorder
en: DIAGNOSIS: Oppositional Defiance Disorder
ja: 診断名: 反抗挑発症

key: NOTES: Client displays an alternatively withdrawn and aggressive affect since arrival.
en: NOTES: Client displays an alternatively withdrawn and aggressive affect since arrival.
ja: 所見: 患者は入所以来、引きこもりがちな様子と攻撃的な様子を交互に見せている。

key: Client portrays a level of possessiveness over her siblings that borders on obsession.
en: Client portrays a level of possessiveness over her siblings that borders on obsession.
ja: 患者は、兄弟姉妹に対して執着に近いレベルの独占欲を示している。

key: Client villainizes figures of authority in nearly all cases, and may react aggressively and violently when confronted by such.
en: Client villainizes figures of authority in nearly all cases, and may react aggressively and violently when confronted by such.
ja: 患者はほぼすべての場合において権威者を悪者扱いし、対決すると攻撃的、暴力的に反応することがある。

key: Client has been responsible for several physical altercations, especially when first adjusting to the living environment.
en: Client has been responsible for several physical altercations, especially when first adjusting to the living environment.
ja: 患者は、特に生活環境に適応し始めた当初、複数の暴力的な衝突を起こしている。

key: Client appears to have some disturbances in her memory, describing inconsistent or impossible events, particularly with regards to this writer.
en: Client appears to have some disturbances in her memory, describing inconsistent or impossible events, particularly with regards to this writer.
ja: 患者の記憶には乱れが見られ、特に本記録者に関して、つじつまの合わない、あるいはあり得ない出来事を語ることがある。

key: Client appears to harbor an increasingly unrealistic and violent perception of this writer, even going as far as inventing false circumstances and accusations.
en: Client appears to harbor an increasingly unrealistic and violent perception of this writer, even going as far as inventing false circumstances and accusations.
ja: 患者は本記録者に対し、次第に非現実的かつ暴力的な認識を抱くようになっており、虚偽の状況や告発をでっち上げるまでに至っている。

key: The client appears to compensate for the loss of her parents by acting as the overprotective parent herself.
en: The client appears to compensate for the loss of her parents by acting as the overprotective parent herself.
ja: 患者は両親を失った喪失感を、自ら過保護な親を演じることで埋め合わせているようだ。

key: In taking on the role of the mother figure, she appears to have created a dissonance regarding the missing male parental figure.
en: In taking on the role of the mother figure, she appears to have created a dissonance regarding the missing male parental figure.
ja: 母親役を担うことで、いない父親像との間に不協和を生み出しているようだ。

key: This dissonance and unacknowledged envy has resulted in inappropriate and imagined fantasies and allegations involving male authority figures.
en: This dissonance and unacknowledged envy has resulted in inappropriate and imagined fantasies and allegations involving male authority figures.
ja: この不協和と、自覚されない嫉妬心により、男性の権威者に関する不適切な妄想や告発が生じている。

key: TREATMENT PLAN: Psychoanalytic talk therapy in exploration of how the loss of her parents has affected her relationship with figures of authority.
en: TREATMENT PLAN: Psychoanalytic talk therapy in exploration of how the loss of her parents has affected her relationship with figures of authority.
ja: 治療方針: 両親の喪失が権威者との関係にどう影響しているかを探る、精神分析的対話療法。

key: ECT has been frequently necessitated for emotional regulation in response to delusions and violent outbursts.
en: ECT has been frequently necessitated for emotional regulation in response to delusions and violent outbursts.
ja: 妄想や暴力的な発作への感情調整のため、ECTがたびたび必要とされている。

key: OTHER NOTES: Former client has applied repeatedly for guardianship of her siblings.
en: OTHER NOTES: Former client has applied repeatedly for guardianship of her siblings.
ja: その他所見: 元患者は、兄弟姉妹の後見権を繰り返し申請している。

key: It is the opinion of this writer that such guardianship would ultimately be detrimental to the mental health and stability of these individuals.
en: It is the opinion of this writer that such guardianship would ultimately be detrimental to the mental health and stability of these individuals.
ja: 本記録者の見解では、そのような後見は、最終的に彼らの精神的健康と安定を損なうものである。

key: Due to her tenuous relationship with both authority and reality, Saphira Belrose is unable to provide an adequate home environment.
en: Due to her tenuous relationship with both authority and reality, Saphira Belrose is unable to provide an adequate home environment.
ja: 権威にも現実にも希薄な関係しか築けないサファイラ・ベルローズには、適切な家庭環境を提供することはできない。

key: Furthermore, living in close proximity to one still coping with repressed traumas in such unhealthy ways would likely only exacerbate the siblings' own conflicts.
en: Furthermore, living in close proximity to one still coping with repressed traumas in such unhealthy ways would likely only exacerbate the siblings' own conflicts.
ja: さらに、抑圧されたトラウマにこれほど不健全な形で対処し続けている人物のそばで暮らすことは、兄弟姉妹自身の葛藤を悪化させるだけだろう。

key: All prior requests for guardianship have been denied, and it is hereby formalized that future requests are not to be considered."
en: All prior requests for guardianship have been denied, and it is hereby formalized that future requests are not to be considered."
ja: これまでの後見申請はすべて却下されており、今後の申請も検討しないことをここに正式に定める。」

key: "Charlotte Belrose"
en: "Charlotte Belrose"
ja: 「シャルロット・ベルローズ」

key: AGE AT INTAKE: 6 years
en: AGE AT INTAKE: 6 years
ja: 入所時年齢: 6歳

key: DIAGNOSIS: Antisocial Personality Disorder
en: DIAGNOSIS: Antisocial Personality Disorder
ja: 診断名: 反社会性パーソナリティ障害

key: NOTES: Client struggles to identify and process personal emotions.
en: NOTES: Client struggles to identify and process personal emotions.
ja: 所見: 患者は自身の感情を認識し処理することに困難を抱えている。

key: Client demonstrates a lack of empathy for other individuals.
en: Client demonstrates a lack of empathy for other individuals.
ja: 患者は他者への共感の欠如を示している。

key: Client appears to fixate on dynamics of control, often for the purpose of manipulating others to her own impulses.
en: Client appears to fixate on dynamics of control, often for the purpose of manipulating others to her own impulses.
ja: 患者は支配関係への執着を見せることが多く、しばしば自らの衝動のままに他者を操るために用いている。

key: Client is prone to periodically create power struggles as a method of validation of her own personal agency.
en: Client is prone to periodically create power struggles as a method of validation of her own personal agency.
ja: 患者は、自らの主体性を確認する手段として、周期的に権力争いを引き起こす傾向がある。

key: Client engages in duplicitous behavior seemingly for the sake of doing so, including smuggling contraband into the facility and lying about otherwise inconsequential matters.
en: Client engages in duplicitous behavior seemingly for the sake of doing so, including smuggling contraband into the facility and lying about otherwise inconsequential matters.
ja: 患者は、それ自体が目的であるかのように、施設内への禁制品の密輸や、取るに足らない事柄についての虚偽など、二枚舌の行動をとる。

key: Client believes herself to be personally responsible for the death of her parents, and has thoroughly internalized this as guilt.
en: Client believes herself to be personally responsible for the death of her parents, and has thoroughly internalized this as guilt.
ja: 患者は両親の死について自分に責任があると信じ込んでおり、この罪悪感を完全に内面化している。

key: Her apathetic emotional affect regarding the incident, and her subsequent emotional detachment appear to be coping mechanisms to withstand the trauma.
en: Her apathetic emotional affect regarding the incident, and her subsequent emotional detachment appear to be coping mechanisms to withstand the trauma.
ja: この件に対する無関心な感情表現と、その後の情緒的な距離の置き方は、トラウマに耐えるための対処機制であると考えられる。

key: TREATMENT PLAN: Psychoanalytic talk therapy in exploration of repressed emotions, feelings, and her resistance to vulnerability.
en: TREATMENT PLAN: Psychoanalytic talk therapy in exploration of repressed emotions, feelings, and her resistance to vulnerability.
ja: 治療方針: 抑圧された感情や心情、そして弱さを見せることへの抵抗感を探る、精神分析的対話療法。

key: ECT has been explored as a tool to reconnect with and process otherwise-unfelt emotions.
en: ECT has been explored as a tool to reconnect with and process otherwise-unfelt emotions.
ja: ECTは、他では感じられない感情との再接続と処理を助ける手段として検討されている。

en: DIAGNOSIS: Auditory and Visual Hallucinations

key: NOTES: Provided by an anonymous party.
en: NOTES: Provided by an anonymous party.

key: Client demonstrates a worsening disconnect from reality.
en: Client demonstrates a worsening disconnect from reality.
ja: 患者は現実とのかい離が悪化する様子を示している。

en: Client reports visual hallucinations, such as seeing non-existent burns, scrapes, and moisture around other people.
ja: 患者は、他人の周りに存在しない火傷や擦り傷、湿り気が見えるといった幻視を訴えている。

key: Client reports hearing voices coming from imaginary friends or other unknown sources.
en: Client reports hearing voices coming from imaginary friends or other unknown sources.
ja: 患者は、空想上の友人や正体不明の何かから聞こえる声を訴えている。

key: As client matures, client appears to believe in these 'friends' more concretely, rather than less.
en: As client matures, client appears to believe in these 'friends' more concretely, rather than less.
ja: 患者は成長するにつれ、これらの「友人」をより具体的に信じるようになっているようだ。

key: Symptoms first began around the age of 9.
en: Symptoms first began around the age of 9.
ja: 症状は9歳頃に初めて現れた。

key: Client does not yet meet other conditions for early diagnosis schizophrenia, but the situation will continue to be monitored as it develops.
en: Client does not yet meet other conditions for early diagnosis schizophrenia, but the situation will continue to be monitored as it develops.
ja: 患者は現時点で統合失調症の早期診断基準を満たしていないが、今後も経過を観察していく。

key: It is possible these hallucinations are a disingenuine, attention-seeking pattern of behavior.
en: It is possible these hallucinations are a disingenuine, attention-seeking pattern of behavior.
ja: これらの幻覚は、注意を引くための虚偽的な行動パターンである可能性もある。

key: This could serve to allow her to create an elevated sense of significance in lack of other legitimate emotional connections.
en: This could serve to allow her to create an elevated sense of significance in lack of other legitimate emotional connections.
ja: これにより、正当な感情的つながりが不足する中で、自らの重要性を高めた感覚を作り出しているのかもしれない。

key: Staff are advised to ignore all claims of nonexistent stimuli so as to not enable deceptive behavior.
en: Staff are advised to ignore all claims of nonexistent stimuli so as to not enable deceptive behavior.
ja: 職員は、ぎまん的な行動を助長しないよう、存在しない刺激についての訴えはすべて無視することが望ましい。

key: TREATMENT PLAN: Psychoanalytic talk therapy for the purpose of directly acknowledging repressed feelings of loneliness and isolation.
en: TREATMENT PLAN: Psychoanalytic talk therapy for the purpose of directly acknowledging repressed feelings of loneliness and isolation.
ja: 治療方針: 抑圧された孤独感と孤立感を直接認めることを目的とした、精神分析的対話療法。

key: ECT has been used to experiment with its affects on the reported hallucinations.
en: ECT has been used to experiment with its affects on the reported hallucinations.
ja: ECTは、報告されている幻覚への効果を試すために使用されている。

key: On several occasions, the client reported no longer hearing the described stimulus after sessions, however, this success has been inconsistent.
en: On several occasions, the client reported no longer hearing the described stimulus after sessions, however, this success has been inconsistent.
ja: 数回にわたり、施術後に該当の刺激が聞こえなくなったと患者は報告しているが、この効果は一貫していない。

key: Client also demonstrates a particular despondence in occasions where he feels unincluded-- indicative of sensitivity to neglect.
en: Client also demonstrates a particular despondence in occasions where he feels unincluded-- indicative of sensitivity to neglect.
ja: また、疎外感を覚える場面では特に落ち込む様子を見せており、これは放置されることへの敏感さを示している。

key: It is likely that his awareness of the circumstances of his arrival to the facility contribute to a perceived sense of inferiority.

ja: 施設に来ることになった経緯を自覚していることが、劣等感の一因になっていると考えられる。

key: TREATMENT PLAN: Psychoanalytic talk therapy for the purpose of directly acknowledging repressed feelings of abandonment and neglect.

key: ECT has been used in exploration of the effects it might have on cognitive processing.
en: ECT has been used in exploration of the effects it might have on cognitive processing.
ja: ECTは、認知処理への影響を探るために使用されている。
